instrument_findings.name: flex-pricing-basis
instrument_findings.class: TRANCHE-2 BINDING REQUIREMENT + repo-wide meta caveat
instrument_findings.finding: cost_estimate.total_cost_usd is a LIST-rate figure in every run.meta.json in the repo (estimate_cost() has no service-tier parameter; lib_llm_metadata.py:1037). Any recompute of a flex-priced prose figure from that field manufactures a ~2x MISMATCH. The tranche-2 cost/token runner must price from token counts at the model's rates with the flex multiplier when the run was flex, per the token-load audit's audited path. Same-family rows elsewhere in the corpus are likely one instrument bug, not independent findings.
